transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I'm here because of what's been going on at work. I drive a truck at a warehouse, and... the routing system we use, it isn't just a regular computer to me anymore. I know it's been marking my moves. It's actually sending messages through the scanners to try and push me out, just because I'm one of the old hands there.
Have you been feeling unusually high or euphoric lately?

No, not at all. I haven't felt high or... euphoric, no. Honestly, it's pretty much the exact opposite. I just feel really worn down by all of this. There's definitely no good feelings going on right now.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

Yeah, I have. I mean... even when I'm just sitting in my garage at home, with everything completely shut off, I hear them. I hear the dispatch voices clear as day. They call out my operator number, and they keep saying that I'm dangerous, or that security is coming for me. There's no one else around, but I hear it like they're right there.
How long have you been hearing those dispatch voices?
It's been about... a year and eight months now. Both the voices and the whole thing with the scanners, it's been going on for that long.
Have you had any serious medical or neurological illness, like a head injury, seizures, or a brain problem, around the time this started?

No, nothing like that. I haven't had any head injuries or... seizures, no. I haven't been sick with anything major physically, either. As far as I know, there's nothing wrong with my brain like that. It's just... just everything I've been telling you about.
Have you found yourself losing interest or motivation to do things you used to do?

Yeah, I have. I used to... well, fishing, going to choir practice, and just tinkering with wood out in the garage, those things used to really settle me down. But now, I can look right at my fishing rods or my tools, and I just... I feel absolutely no pull to touch them. The interest just isn't there anymore.
